paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan tengteng akhawmkhawm a, akiang uah: "Hiaitę na hih ding ua TOUPA thupiakte ahi.
heading: Sabbath Tandan Ding
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

paite: Ni guk sung in nna sep zoh ahi dia, himahleh ani sagih ni noute a dia inn om ni ahi ding hi. TOUPA a dia Sabbath khawlna ahi. Sabbath ni a noute a dia inn om ni: Hiai ni nna sem peuhmah thah ding ahi.
english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

paite: Sabbath ni in na tenna peuh uah mei na chih ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

paite: Israel suan kikhawmkhawm tengteng kiang ah Mosi in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N noute ahon thupiak hiaite ahi uh.
heading: Puanin Siangthou Thillat / (Eks 25.1-9)
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

paite: TOUPA a ding in na lak uah thilpiakte lakhawm un. Lungtang a utna nei kuapeuh in TOUPA a ding in thilpiakte: dangka-eng, dangka leh dal;
english: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

paite: khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

paite: belampa mul diahsan, ngalvang vun, singgi sing;
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

paite: khawnvak a ding thau, thaunilh ding in gimlim; hal namtui ding;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

paite: onik suangte, siampu puanak leh awmtuam a siat ding suangmantamte hon tawikhawm uhen," achi hi.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

paite: "Na lak ua khutsiam tengteng na hong pai ding ua, TOUPA'N bawl ding chi a thu ahon piak tengteng abawl ding uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Vante / (Eks 39.32-43)
english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

paite: Biakbuk, apuanin, akhuhna, asikkawi, asingpekte, asiktawnte, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte;
english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

paite: abawm leh achiangte, zahngaihna tutphah leh akhuhna puanzak;
english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

paite: dohkan leh achiangte, atui-um belsuan leh tanghou koihna;
english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

paite: khawnvak a ding in khawnvak koihna leng, avante, akhawnvakte, avakna thau;
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

paite: gimlim maitam leh achiangte, nilh theih thau, gimlim leh biakbuk lutna kongkhak a dia puankhai,
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

paite: halmang thillatna maitam, adal vutluah, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

paite: ahuangsung puankhaite, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, huangsung kongkhak a dia puankhai;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

paite: biakbuk kilhna zumte, huangsung kilhna zumte leh akhaute;
english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

paite: nasepna puante, mun siangthou a nasepna dia siampu Aaron puan siangthoute, atapate puante bawl uhen," achi hi.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan kikhawm teng Mosi omna a pan apaita uhi.
heading: Mipite Tawi Thillatte
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

paite: Michih alungtang tohthoh a om peuhmah leh michih utna nei peuhmahte ahong pai ua, kihoupihna biakbuk lamna ding leh asung a nasepna ding leh puansilh siangthoute bawlna ding TOUPA ma ah thilpiak ahon tawi uhi.
english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

paite: Lungtang a utna nei pasalte leh numeite ahong pai ua, dangka-eng a kibawl thil tuamtuam: bilbah, nakbah, zungbuh, ohthoh leh butthoh kizepnate ahon tawi ua, TOUPA mai ah alan uhi.
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul, belampa vun, ngalvang vun neite'n huaite ahon tawi uhi.
english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

paite: Thilpiak dia dangka leh dal neite'n TOUPA mai a thillat ding in ahon tawi uhi. Singgi sing nei teng in leng ahon tawi uhi.
english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

paite: Numei khutsiam teng in khut in khau akhek ua, akheksa uh ahon tawi ua, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih ahon tawi uhi.
english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

paite: Lungtang tohthoh numei tengteng in kel mul akhek uhi.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

paite: Vaihawm mite'n onik suangte, suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuam a siat dingte ahon tawi uhi;
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

paite: gimnamtui hal ding singgah namtui leh det ding meivak leh nilh ding sathau a zat ding leh gimnamtui a hel ding sathau ahon tawi uhi.
english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak a, van bawl ding achih tengteng bawlna ding in Israel suante, numei leh pasalte'n amau ut thu in thilpiakte TOUPA mai ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

paite: Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah, "En un, TOUPA'N Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi amin in asam a;
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawlmite Bezalel leh Aholiab / (Eks 31.1-11)
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

paite: Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna chiteng in amah adimsak hi.
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

paite: Huai bel khutsiamtak a bawl dingte gelsiamna, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal thilbawlsiamna ahi a, bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna ahi.
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

paite: bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna leh khutsiam thilbawl chiteng asiamna ahi.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

paite: Huan amah leh Dan nam a Ahisamak tapa Aholiab leng midangte sinsak siamna apia hi.
english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

paite: Amaute teng khuakthoh a thilbawl siamna chikim leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih gat zep siamna, gat siamna, ze tuamtuam gelh siamna nei ding in pilna apia hi," achi hi.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
